text:
Noah (Design): Flagging a few tiny UI regressions from last layout pass: toast position overlaps the kebab menu on narrow dashboards, and the table action column feels cramped. Thoughts?
Jess (Frontend): can repro. On 1024px width the kebab (more actions) sits under a toast if both present. Looks like toast uses `--space-4` which we tightened recently.
Maya (A11y): also noticed icon-only actions in tables missing aria-labels. On VoiceOver the row actions announce nothing.
Kai (PM): users reported accidental taps on tiny icons in modals too. We should standardize hit-targets across components.
Noah (Design): proposal: 1) toast anchors should be viewport-anchored (not within panels), 2) add a compact toast variant for single-line messages that uses `--space-2` padding, 3) enforce 44px hit targets for icon controls, 4) make action column `min-width: 72px` and collapse to a kebab on small widths.
Jess (Frontend): implementation notes: current toasts are inside the panel DOM so they inherit overflow/clipping. Portaling to body and using `position: fixed` will solve stacking. For the kebab overlap, we can add a small offset when a toast is present or reserve `--toast-offset` token.
Maya (A11y): important: do not auto-focus toasts. Use `aria-live="polite"` and ensure kebab has `aria-label="More actions"`. For hit targets, keep visual icon at 16px but wrap in a 44px button.
Noah (Design): CSS snippet for icon hit target: ```css
.icon-wrapper { width: 44px; height: 44px; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; }
.icon { width: 16px; height: 16px; }
```
Jess (Frontend): will open a PR to: portal toasts to body, add `toast--compact`, expose `--toast-offset`, enforce icon wrappers in table actions, and add migration notes for spacing tokens. Will include Percy diffs.
design-bot: Note: RFC #5091 (spacing tokens) may touch `--space-2/4` naming. Check before merge. https://git.mock/rfc/5091
Kai (PM): acceptance: no toast/kebab overlap at common widths, table actions accessible, hit targets >=44px, docs updated with token guidance.
Maya (A11y): please include keyboard tests for kebab and ensure screen reader announces action menu.
Noah (Design): tiny copy nit for docs: prefer "More actions" label and sentence case in examples. Thanks all :sparkles:
